title: Joey Wants to Sit Near Mia

sequence.title: BACKGROUND SETTING
sequence.text: Mia found a comfy spot and started building a tower with the blocks. Joey came over, excited to sit with her.

sequence.speaker: Joey
sequence.text: Whoa, cool tower! Scoot over, I wanna sit right next to you!

sequence.speaker: Mia
sequence.text: Hmm, I feel a little bit squished if you sit here too.

sequence.title: Joey's Decision
sequence.decision_prompt: What should Joey do after Mia says she feels squished?
